label: TARGET_DIVER_SELECTOR_V2_FREEZE
rationale: S3_ACTION_GLOBAL_PATH was designed and evaluated as the primary V2 candidate. S3 adds a spatial-persistence motion auxiliary (penalises candidates that appear persistently at the same location across the full sequence, i.e. static background FPs) and scale plausibility. On DEVELOPMENT: S3=48.4% ALL (15/31) vs S1=51.6% (16/31) — 1-frame regression on dive 133 takeoff, and dive 2625 now selects wrong target instead of safely returning NULL. S3 shows directional improvement at Paris (water_contact: MATCH with conf=0.121, iou=0.511 vs S1 WRONG) but takeoff and apex remain wrong. Per packet Phase I instruction (choose using DEVELOPMENT only), S1 remains the chosen selector. S3 Paris finding is recorded as a directional result supporting the motion-auxiliary approach in future work.

S3_paris_finding.water_contact: S3 MATCH (iou=0.511, dist=0.042, conf=0.121) vs S1 WRONG (conf=0.311, dist=0.536)
S3_paris_finding.takeoff: S3 WRONG (dist=0.192) vs S1 WRONG (dist=0.295) — both wrong, S3 closer
S3_paris_finding.apex: S3 WRONG (dist=0.454) vs S1 WRONG (dist=0.4) — both wrong
S3_paris_finding.interpretation: Persistence penalty partially breaks static-FP lock at Paris; insufficient for full trajectory gate pass.

algorithm: Deterministic Viterbi (dynamic programming) over per-frame states = {every raw D3.1 candidate at t} union {NULL} — identical to TARGET_DIVER_SELECTOR_V1_FREEZE.json
scoring_terms: Unchanged from V1: log(conf) observation, spatial continuity + scale-change transition, C_REACQUIRE/C_NULL_HOLD costs, post-hoc INVALID_STATIC_TRACK rolling window rejection.
paris_firewall: Paris labels MUST NOT adjust any parameter in this file. Paris was evaluated post-freeze for external validation only.
